summary.value: An interactive React demo of CKEditor AI configuration and customization: AI Chat, Quick Actions, and Review Mode explored through five hands-on tasks in a realistic content management interface.

content.value:
What's inside

A React application demonstrating CKEditor AI in a real-world content management interface. Five guided hands-on tasks walk through configuring and customizing AI Chat, Quick Actions, and Review Mode - so instead of reading about the AI features, you change their behavior and watch what happens.
